title: Longitudinal and Graph-Augmented Prediction of Adolescent Substance Use Onset in the ABCD Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.14578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early identification of adolescent substance-use risk is an important prevention challenge, yet the relative value of baseline characteristics, longitudinal trajectories, and relational context remains unclear. Using data from approximately 11,860 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we compare cross-sectional, longitudinal, and graph-based approaches for predicting alcohol sipping, alcohol use, marijuana use, and alcohol/marijuana use. We evaluate tree-based models, recurrent neural networks, and Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (T-GCNs) constructed from family, school, and feature-similarity graphs. Longitudinal models consistently outperform baseline models, with temporal XGBoost achieving the strongest standalone performance. translated_title: ABCD研究中青少年物质使用起始的纵向与图增强预测
translated_abstract: 早期识别青少年物质使用风险是一个重要的预防挑战，但基线特征、纵向轨迹和关系背景的相对价值仍不明确。利用青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究中约11，860名参与者的数据，我们比较了横截面、纵向和基于图的方法，用于预测酒精小酌、酒精使用、大麻使用以及酒精/大麻使用。我们评估了基于树的模型、循环神经网络和由家庭、学校及特征相似性图构建的时间图卷积网络（T-GCNs）。纵向模型始终优于基线模型，其中时间XGBoost实现了最强的独立性能。尽管T-GCNs通常未超越时间XGBoost，但图衍生的风险评分提供了补充信息。将时间XGBoost和T-GCN预测结合使用，可进一步提升预测准确性。
tldr: 本研究发现纵向模型优于横截面模型，时间XGBoost表现最佳，且结合图卷积网络的风险评分能提供互补信息，从而更有效地预测青少年物质使用起始风险。
en_tdlr: This study finds that longitudinal models outperform cross-sectional ones, with temporal XGBoost achieving the best standalone performance, and integrating graph-based risk scores provides complementary information for more effective prediction of adolescent substance use onset.
